en.headline: Mainland man arrested with five signal flares at West Kowloon station
en.dek: A 49-year-old dual-permit holder was detained after security screening found the items in his luggage; he is being held on suspicion of manufacturing or possessing explosives.
body: Police arrested a 49-year-old mainland Chinese man at the Hong Kong West Kowloon Station of the high-speed rail on Wednesday afternoon after security staff found five suspected signal flares in his luggage.

Staff at the station reported the discovery at about 2.30pm during routine X-ray screening of the man’s baggage as he prepared to depart for the mainland. Officers from Yau Tsim Police District attended and arrested the dual-permit holder, surnamed Li, on suspicion of manufacturing or possessing explosives.

No one was injured. The man was detained for further inquiries by the district’s criminal investigation team. Signal flares are classified as dangerous goods under Hong Kong law and may only be possessed under strict conditions.

zh.headline: 西九高鐵站內地男藏五枚信號彈被捕
zh.dek: 49歲持雙程證男子下午安檢時被揭行李藏有懷疑信號彈，涉製造或管有炸藥被扣查。
body: 警方周三下午在高鐵西九龍站拘捕一名49歲持雙程證的內地男子，涉嫌製造或管有炸藥。
約下午2時半，車站職員在安檢時以X光檢查發現該名姓李男子的行李內藏有五枚懷疑信號彈，隨即報警。油尖警區人員到場後將他拘捕，交由該區刑事調查隊跟進，現正被扣留調查。
事件中無人受傷。信號彈屬危險品，在香港法例下受嚴格規管，一般人士不得管有。
警方表示調查仍在進行。
